neighbours.label: customer-service and order-policy text addressing a customer (a representative will, we will charge, please call), peaking on ' will'
fire: If your parcel arrives damaged, call our helpline and an agent will arrange a replacement.
For returns, please include your order number and our team will process the refund.
Once you submit the form, a support specialist will contact you within two days.
Please note that we will charge a restocking fee on opened items.
Contact our service desk at the number below and a representative will assist you.
If you need to change your booking, reply to this email and we will update it.
Customers who cancel after shipping will be billed for postage both ways.
Questions about your invoice? Our billing staff will be happy to help.
quiet: The old ferry will cross the strait one last time before it is scrapped.
Forecasters say the storm will reach the coast late on Thursday night.
In the final chapter the hero will learn the truth about his father.
Experts think the price of copper will rise again next year.
The comet will be visible from the southern hemisphere in March.
Historians wonder whether the treaty will survive the new government.
The orchestra will perform the symphony in the cathedral this spring.
Scientists expect the glacier will lose a third of its mass.

notes: card: top examples are customer-care instructions ('a customer care representative will', 'We will charge', hotline colon). Near misses use 'will' in narrative or forecast prose with no customer being addressed.
